requirements.title: SD Card Initialization at Startup
requirements.description: The SD library shall initialize the SD card during power-on self-test.
requirements.rationale: FT1 POST must probe the SD card so the operator knows pre-flight whether logging storage is available.

requirements.title: SD Card Capacity Reporting
requirements.description: The SD library shall report the SD card capacity after successful initialization.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: capacity is observable at POST so the operator can confirm sufficient storage exists pre-flight.

requirements.title: Run Directory Creation Per Power-On
requirements.description: The SD library shall create a new run directory on each power-on.
requirements.rationale: FT1 requires each power-on to start a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.

requirements.title: Prior Run Preservation
requirements.description: The SD library shall preserve prior run directories without modification or deletion.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: prior flight data is protected against accidental overwrite between runs.

requirements.title: Sequential Byte Write Surface
requirements.description: The SD library shall accept sequential byte writes into a file within the current run directory.
requirements.rationale: FT1 mission log writes raw, nav, and event bytes; the SD library provides the write surface.

requirements.title: Format-Agnostic Byte-Through Writes
requirements.description: The SD library shall write caller-supplied bytes verbatim without modification.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: SD library does not define log format; mlog_lib supplies machine-parseable bytes.

requirements.title: Sustain Full-Rate Logging Throughput
requirements.description: The SD library shall sustain write throughput sufficient for full-rate FSW sensor and nav logging.
requirements.rationale: FT1 logs sensors at full sample rate plus nav and events; the SD library must keep up without backpressure.

requirements.title: Continue Writes After Transient Failure
requirements.description: The SD library shall continue attempting writes after a write failure.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: SD failures must not halt mission; the library retries writes on transient errors.

requirements.title: Write Failure Status Reporting
requirements.description: The SD library shall return a failure status on each write that does not complete successfully.
requirements.rationale: PM decision: SD write failures must be observable so the health state can flag the SD card unhealthy.

requirements.title: Continuous Health Status
requirements.description: The SD library shall publish a health status reflecting recent write success.
requirements.rationale: PM-required ongoing health observability so the SD bit of the sensor health bitmap stays current.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The SD library POSIX build shall expose the same write and run-directory behavior as the Pico2 build.
requirements.rationale: PM-required so Trick simulation exercises the same logging paths as flight hardware.

requirements.title: Deterministic Write Behavior
requirements.description: The SD library shall produce identical on-disk bytes given identical inputs.
requirements.rationale: PM-required determinism so Trick sim runs and regression analysis are repeatable.
